[Benzinga news, 2026-10-20T23:01:37Z, by staff] SpaceX and Tesla Exploring Potential Merger
SpaceX and Tesla have established special committees of independent board directors to evaluate a potential merger between the two companies.
SpaceX and Tesla are in the early stages of exploring a potential merger, according to CEO Elon Musk. Both companies have formed special committees consisting of independent board directors to assess the feasibility and structure of a combination. Musk, who serves as CEO and is a major shareholder in both entities, noted that he is not directly involved in the deliberations. While the companies are actively evaluating the prospect, Musk emphasized that a merger is not guaranteed and that progress remains in the preliminary stages.
